title: Find the crash
prompt: This early version of Pocket Budget's add-expense logic works in every demo, then crashes for a real user. Select the line that causes the crash.
hints: Run it in your head with the second call: what does `Decimal(string: "")` return?
Look for the one character that says "I promise this is never nil".
The crash message would be "Unexpectedly found nil while unwrapping an Optional value".
